image.purity_evidence: no kpatch triple recorded for this image; sysent[11] still resolves to kbase+0x4c7ad, which is the value PSFree's 900.c itself writes, so a patch of the same technique cannot be excluded from the table alone

text_twin.note: RX segment only (13,623,480 B = 0xcfe0b8); byte-identical to the 48 MiB image over [0,0xcfe0b8)

sysent.source: derived from two independent published constants and re-verified in the image: PSFree lapse.mjs offset_sysent_661 = 0x1107f00 and kpatch/900.c syscall-11 slot 0x1100520 both imply base 0x1100310 (0x1107f00 - 661*0x30 = 0x1100520 - 11*0x30)

jmp_qword_rsi.source: PSFree kpatch/900.c writes kbase+0x4c7ad into sysent[11]; the image's sysent[11].sy_call reads back exactly that value

anchor_provenance.free: no inventory exists for this firmware; translated from 13.52 free=0x96e0 by callee signature matching inside the aligned aio_multi_delete pair (76 instructions, 0 lock-prefixed, 0 repeat ops, 1 indirect; unique on both sides) and corroborated by direct call-site count (2202 here vs 2211 on 13.52)
anchor_provenance.fdrop_release: same method; 69 instructions, 2 repeat ops, 2 indirect; 3 calls in the aio_multi_delete pair on both sides
anchor_provenance.printf: same method then confirmed by shape: variadic log prologue saving rsi/rdx/rcx/r8/r9 with movabs 0x3000000008; 8929 direct call sites here vs 8917 on 13.52
